title: Tympanometry
authors: ASHA Working Group on Aural Acoustic-Immittance Measurements
supports: 已读术语、仪器、补偿与解释限制部分；历史教程，不作为现行设备标准。

title: Recommended Procedure: Tympanometry and Acoustic Reflex Thresholds
authors: British Society of Audiology, Professional Guidance Group
publication: Official recommended procedure, also amended February 2025
supports: 已读适用年龄、测量与报告、耳道容积、测试条件及宽带概览相关部分；保留原始出版年与修订日期。

title: Acoustic Immittance, Absorbance, and Reflectance in the Human Ear Canal.
authors: Rosowski JJ, Wilber LA.
supports: 综述摘要；声导抗、吸收率、反射率和校准概览。

title: Fundamental Concepts for Assessment and Interpretation of Wideband Acoustic Immittance Measurements.
authors: AlMakadma H, Kei J, Yeager D, Feeney MP.
supports: 已读全文的阻抗、临床测量、宽带吸收率与压力切片相关部分；采用其概念框架，计算和图另行原创。

title: Measurement of acoustic impedance and reflectance in the human ear canal.
authors: Voss SE, Allen JB.
supports: 原始研究摘要；复数声压反射系数、能量反射率与耳道输入阻抗的关系。

title: Ear-canal impedance and reflection coefficient in human infants and adults.
authors: Keefe DH, Bulen JC, Arehart KH, Burns EM.
supports: 原始研究摘要；婴儿耳道壁、几何发育及输入阻抗与反射差异。

title: Tympanometry in newborn infants--1 kHz norms.
authors: Margolis RH, Bass-Ringdahl S, Hanks WD, Holte L, Zapala DA.
supports: 原始研究摘要；新生儿1 kHz鼓室测量与OAE筛查条件相关的常模。

title: A Comparison of 226- and 1000-Hz Probe Tone Tympanometry With Myringotomy Findings in Infants.
authors: Gellrich D, Eder K, Echternach M, Gröger M, Huber P.
supports: 出版者及索引摘要；111名、217耳、≤12个月手术婴儿，226/1000 Hz与鼓膜切开所见的回顾性比较。

title: Longitudinal development of wideband reflectance tympanometry in normal and at-risk infants.
authors: Hunter LL, Keefe DH, Feeney MP, Fitzpatrick DF, Lin L.
supports: 原文可检索方法、结果及讨论相关部分；正常/高风险婴儿纵向测量中的年龄效应，不提取存在差异的总样本数。

title: Normative Wideband Reflectance, Equivalent Admittance at the Tympanic Membrane, and Acoustic Stapedius Reflex Threshold in Adults.
authors: Feeney MP, Keefe DH, Hunter LL, Fitzpatrick DF, Garinis AC, Putterman DB, McMillan GP.
supports: 原始研究摘要；33名正常听力成人，约一个月重测，环境压力及双方向扫描的常模和可靠性。

title: Air-leak effects on ear-canal acoustic absorbance.
authors: Groon KA, Rasetshwane DM, Kopun JG, Gorga MP, Neely ST.
supports: 已读全文方法、结果及结论相关部分；人工漏气、刚性腔与21名成人的耳道测量。

title: Effect of Negative Middle Ear Pressure and Compensated Pressure on Wideband Absorbance and Otoacoustic Emissions in Children.
authors: Aithal S, Aithal V, Kei J, Manuel A.
supports: 原始研究摘要；儿童负中耳压下环境/峰压WBA及TEOAE比较，改善有频率条件。

title: Wideband acoustic transfer functions predict middle-ear effusion.
authors: Ellison JC, Gorga M, Cohn E, Fitzpatrick D, Sanford CA, Keefe DH.
supports: 原始诊断研究摘要；年轻儿童环境压力宽带响应与积液判断，不据标题推广。

title: Improving the Differential Diagnosis of Otitis Media With Effusion Using Wideband Acoustic Immittance.
authors: Merchant GR, Al-Salim S, Tempero RM, Fitzpatrick D, Neely ST.
supports: 原始研究摘要；儿童术前WAI与术中积液分类、同数据集内模型验证及传统鼓室图比较。

title: Comparison of ear-canal reflectance and umbo velocity in patients with conductive hearing loss: a preliminary study.
authors: Nakajima HH, Pisano DV, Roosli C, Hamade MA, Merchant GR, Mahfoud L, Halpin CF, Rosowski JJ, Merchant SN.
supports: 原始研究摘要；2012年发表，31名成人，鼓膜完整且中耳含气，反射率配合测听的初步鉴别研究。

title: Measurement of Wideband Absorbance as a Test for Otosclerosis.
authors: Śliwa L, Kochanek K, Jedrzejczak WW, Mrugała K, Skarżyński H.
supports: 已读全文结果及结论相关部分，并核对摘要；90只术证耳和126名匹配正常听力对照，峰压低频吸收率判别。

title: Ear-canal reflectance, umbo velocity, and tympanometry in normal-hearing adults.
authors: Rosowski JJ, Nakajima HH, Hamade MA, Mahfoud L, Merchant GR, Halpin CF, Merchant SN.
supports: 摘要核对；正常听力成人耳道反射率、脐部速度与鼓室图的频率相关性；沿用本次对话已核对记录。

title: Auditory brainstem circuits that mediate the middle ear muscle reflex.
authors: Mukerji S, Windsor AM, Lee DJ.
supports: 综述摘要；中耳肌反射的双侧反应、镫骨肌及脑干通路，不将所有中继细胞当作已确定。

title: The middle ear muscle reflex: Current and future role in assessing noise-induced cochlear damage.
authors: Trevino M, Zang A, Lobarinas E.
supports: 综述摘要；动物噪声突触损伤与宽带MEMR关联，人类结果异质性及应用限制。

title: Test-Retest Differences in the Wideband Middle Ear Muscle Reflex.
authors: Bramhall NF, Whittle NK, Feeney MP, McMillan GP.
supports: 原始研究摘要；2025年发表（DOI含2024），45名成人两次对侧宽带MEMR的重测差异。

title: Absorbance Measurements From Normal-hearing Ears in the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey, 2015-2016 and 2017-2020.
authors: Sun J, Horton NJ, Voss SE.
supports: 原始研究摘要；7029耳、4150人、6—80岁NHANES正常听力及有效数据筛选，群体差异和社区测量。

title: Age effect on wideband absorbance in people with normal middle ear function: a systematic review.
authors: Zhao F, Suresh SC, Jones E, Cao Z, Zhang L, Wang J, Grais EM, Rajenderkumar D, Lauxmann M, Jiang W.
supports: 系统综述摘要；30项研究的年龄分层，未阅读全文及逐项重新提取数据。

title: A novel approach to the follow up of children with otitis media with effusion: wideband absorbance findings.
authors: Keskin Yıldız M, Atay G, Mergen EK, Aksoy S, Böke B.
supports: 已读全文方法、结果与结论相关部分；26名儿童48耳、三个月积液随访，WBA改变与耳镜所见的关联。

title: Survey of Wideband Acoustic Immittance Use by Clinical Audiologists.
authors: Al-Salim S, Skretta D, Merchant GR.
supports: 原始调查摘要；132名美国临床听力师，自愿调查中的设备、培训及解释信心障碍。
